_README: Website images (stock placeholders until you have your own photos). To change an image: replace 'src' with another Unsplash photo address (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-...) OR a file you put in /assets/images/site/ (for example /assets/images/site/hero.webp). Update 'alt' to describe the new picture, and 'credit'/'page' if it is a new stock photo. 'position' moves the crop focus: center, top, bottom, left or right. These stock photos are decorative and are NOT presented as Amiri's own completed jobs.
